name: PRAY for LOVE | Toward The Stars ★☆
source:
My name is "Nga". I'm being quite happy with my life. Having a lot of friends. And, parents aren't too strict to me. The only thing would make me confused is that my mind is always not clear when just waking up…

Love still exists in this world, so human beings won't be extinct. I think so.

I hope the world becomes more beautiful… Therefore, I prayed quietly, to the far far stars outside the sky.

A short story about a couple in the far future.

[Edited from [url=https://hoi-hoi-hoi.itch.io/pray-for-love-toward-the-stars-]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
我的名字是“Nga”。我对自己的生活很满意。有很多朋友。而且，父母对我也不是太严格。唯一让我困惑的是，刚睡醒的时候脑子总是不太清醒……

这个世界上还有爱，所以人类不会灭绝。我想是的。

我希望世界变得更加美好……于是，我默默地祈祷，向天外遥远的星星。

关于遥远未来的一对情侣的短篇故事。

[编辑自[url=https://hoi-hoi-hoi.itch.io/pray-for-love-toward-the-stars-]itch.io[/url]]
